Goal: A TypeScript tic tac toe game for the browser: a clickable 3x3 board in the DOM, a computer opponent that uses minimax so it never loses, a score counter, and a restart button.

Write the skeleton of the whole game as one TypeScript code block: types, top-level variables with their types, and every function with its full typed signature and a one-line comment above it saying what it does. Every function body must be only `// TODO`. Include the code at the bottom that sets up the page and starts the game.
output:

'cell-white' : 'cell-black'; board.innerHTML += `
${cell.value}

'cell-white' : 'cell-black'; return cell.value === '' && !isCellEmpty(cell); } // Function to handle a click event function handleClick(e) { const cellId = e.target.id; const cell = boardArray[cellId]; if (canMove(cell)) { if (cell.isHuman) { // If it's the player's turn, we place their mark cell.value = 'X'; cell.color = 'white'; } else { // Computer's turn if (computerPlayer.isComputer) { // Check for win for computer if (checkWin(computerPlayer)) { alert('Computer wins!'); } // Otherwise, make a move computerPlayer.value++; cell.value = 'O'; cell.color = 'black'; } else { // If it's not the computer's turn, we check for win for human if (checkWin(cell)) { alert('You win!'); } // Otherwise, place a mark cell.value = 'X'; cell.color = 'white'; } } } } // Function to check if a player has won function checkWin(player) { // Check rows for (let row = 0; row < boardHeight; row++) { if (player.value === player.value[0] && player.value === player.value[1] && player.value === player.value[2]) { return true;
